title: NBA Sim Resolve Contract (foundation 0.1.0)
description: Frozen homogeneous resolve contract for v0.1.0. All players share identical talent in this phase; outcome probabilities depend only on the base_rate for the situation, situation modifiers (pinned at neutral in v0.1.0), and one rng.next() draw. NO per-player talent field exists in this model. Sanity bands are targets the pace/possession regression (T21) will assert across seeds 1..256.

foundation_version.description: Semver stamp of the resolve contract. Must match config/foundation.json#foundation_version.

model.description: Resolve model identifier. v0.1.0 ships `homogeneous_v0_1`; any change here is a major foundation_version bump.

pass_success.description: P(an in-bounds pass reaches its receiver).

handoff_success.description: P(a handoff completes cleanly to the receiver).

drive_success.description: P(a drive reaches the rim without being stripped or stopped).

shot_make_2pt.description: P(a released 2-point shot is made). Homogeneous baseline; no per-shooter talent in v0.1.0.

shot_make_3pt.description: P(a released 3-point shot is made). Homogeneous baseline.

shot_type_block_bias.description: P1.3 block-rate multiplier per shot type.

zone_modifiers_3pt.description: Per-zone 3PT make-rate modifiers (NBA-empirical: corner ≈ +8% vs wings, flat elsewhere). Applied ONLY to 3-point attempts — the 2PT zone_modifiers table must not be reused for threes.

pace_per_team_min.description: Lower bound on per-team possessions per 48 minutes (M8 pace band).

pace_per_team_max.description: Upper bound on per-team possessions per 48 minutes.

mean_possession_length_seconds_min.description: Lower bound on mean live-ball possession length.

mean_possession_length_seconds_max.description: Upper bound on mean live-ball possession length.

transition_share_min.description: Lower bound on TRANSITION possession share.

transition_share_max.description: Upper bound on TRANSITION possession share.

fg_pct_min.description: Lower bound on aggregate field-goal percentage across the seeds 1..256 pace regression (T21).

fg_pct_max.description: Upper bound on aggregate field-goal percentage.

score_per_team_min.description: Lower bound on mean per-team final score.

score_per_team_max.description: Upper bound on mean per-team final score.

oreb_pct_min.description: Lower bound on aggregate offensive-rebound percentage.

oreb_pct_max.description: Upper bound on aggregate offensive-rebound percentage.

scv_rate_min.description: Lower bound on shot-clock-violation rate (P0 structural health diagnostic).

sanity_bands.$comment: sanity_bands is the single runtime authority for every diagnostic band (reality-scan, pace-check). The `*_max >= *_min` invariants are enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs and the visual jq audit. A pace_band_note string was considered and dropped: documentation belongs in docs, not the data contract.

allowed.$comment: Phase-1 ONLY personal shooting fouls (decision Metis G3.3). minItems=maxItems=4 plus the items enum restricted to the 4 canonical values together force the array to be a 4-element permutation of those values; the three allOf branches below additionally pin presence of 3_shot, and_one_1_shot, and bonus_2_shot (the items enum already constrains every element, and `contains` for 2_shot would be redundant given length 4 + the other three branches).

forbidden.description: FT types excluded from Phase-1: technical fouls, flagrant fouls of either degree, and clear-path fouls. Adding any of these is a major foundation_version bump.

allOf.$comment: Enforce all 4 allowed entries are present (order-independent).

team_fouls_per_period_threshold.description: Team foul count within the current period at which the bonus is triggered. v0.1.0 pins 5 per NBA rule; subsequent non-shooting fouls award 2 FTs (the bonus_2_shot taxonomy entry).

description.description: Human-readable summary of the bonus rule.
